agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario is fast grazing collision with thin horizontal wall (h=0.2). Body approaches at ~58 m/s with vx~46.5. Despite 7 substeps per step, positional correction / discrete collision handling fails to prevent penetration when body grazes top surface of thin wall: at step 39 distance_to_surface = +0.0075 (just outside), step 40 = -0.072 (penetrating 0.072), step 41 = -0.1517 exceeding 0.15 limit. High tangential velocity causes tunneling/grazing penetration accumulating beyond tolerance. Reducing initial speed eliminates violation.
